notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Welcome Brainers,

Today's a new update bring our 5th race: Under water.
We enhanced the speed in the races for lots more fun and action.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Brainers,

A new update has come it way!
A fourth race called "Mental Freedom" has been added.  Race through a green and happy forest with your friends.
Lots of rebalance to make AI more challenging on all four races.
We also added musics and fixed some troubles with the volumes of musics and sounds.
We standardised the UI through all the modes.
Finally, lots of bug fix.

We hope you enjoy this patch!

notes.title: New update: Dodgeball
notes.notes:
A brand new mode is now available: PvP Dodgeball.
Play with 2 to 4 players in this epic fight to avoid balls and complete your puzzle!

A third race also has been added: Flash of Genius

notes.title: Update 2.0.0 - Speedy Brain Racing Mode
notes.notes:
Here it is, the new racing mode is ready to play in the first out of 5 races that will be available in a near future. 

1 - Watch out for obstacles
2 - Gather ideas in your trailer 
3 - Win the race 

This update also include major UI updates and general Bugfixes/Improvements

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed controls selection.
- Modified multiplayer points calculation method. 
- Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
After some feedbacks regarding the rotation precision, we made a litte upgrade.

You can now control rotation speed really precisely with the triggers.

Hope you guys enjoy it !! :)
